denominator: 26 audit categories, analyst-selected; not a standards requirements denominator and not a percentage score

statuses.bounded-tested: implemented with bounded test evidence; currentness qualified separately
statuses.partial: implemented pieces or recorded tests, but incomplete general integration or production scope
statuses.external-binding: separate implemented component needing an explicit app/runtime binding
statuses.not-established: not demonstrated in the selected source/evidence scope; not a claim of repository-wide absence

rows.evidence: 13 backend meta-types; TypeScript/Python/Rust outputs; compiler certificates and source binding. Earlier 71-test reconciliation epoch passed.
rows.remaining: Current Alch checkout has 3 changed bound source files; repeat an exact candidate check before carrying that result forward.

rows.evidence: Typed contracts, explicit guards, exact numeric profiles and Node/Rust portable function evidence.
rows.remaining: Supported profiles differ; arbitrary business semantics and universal language parity are not established. Older portable manifest has drift.

rows.evidence: Generated Node/Rust functions and loopback HTTP host; input, actor and grant checks.
rows.remaining: Semantic host supports one producer, one consumer, one transition and optional scalar assignment per operation. Not arbitrary service topology or a generated UI.

rows.evidence: SQLite atomic state/outbox and projection/inbox; experimental Postgres transactional outbox APIs.
rows.remaining: Provider-neutral declarations do not implement a database. Cross-service transactions and production database topology need exact adapters and tests.

rows.evidence: Durable local delivery, retry limits, leases, fenced settlement, inbox deduplication and local dead letters.
rows.remaining: Remote broker semantics and dead-letter publication remain separate; no exactly-once transport claim.

rows.evidence: Durable recovery runtime, independent observer, adapter and ORODI campaign: recorded 30 scenarios x 2.
rows.remaining: B05 has one missing source and expired freshness window; current adapter test fails on that source. No universal distributed recovery claim.

rows.evidence: Version-bound plans, generated default mappings, snapshot rehearsal, separate storage generations, route recovery.
rows.remaining: Bounded additive/explicit ownership changes; arbitrary destructive transforms, online rolling migrations and multi-node cutover are not established.

rows.evidence: Repository/UoW/failure bindings and message/transport/delivery contracts are modeled and validated.
rows.remaining: External resource, adapter and provider identity must be supplied and proven; declaration is not execution.

rows.evidence: RWO/Ansible local host; persistent revision registry; asynchronous tenant-turn build queue and explicit activation.
rows.remaining: Loopback and single-host candidate. Remote allocation, public DNS/TLS and multi-host coordination remain external.

rows.evidence: Tenant-scoped revision access, admission limits and Bubblewrap per-invocation isolation.
rows.remaining: No aggregate cgroup/process/disk quota guarantees, complete seccomp policy or independent public-hosting security result.

rows.evidence: Reusable auth package provides login/token/session/authorization use cases; Auth Foundation has generated deny-by-default Rust decisions.
rows.remaining: These are separate components; full generated-app identity-service integration, browser sessions and CSRF behavior require consumer bindings.

rows.evidence: Scoped operator tokens and auth ports exist.
rows.remaining: End-to-end SAML/OIDC federation, MFA, provisioning/SCIM and enterprise identity lifecycle are not demonstrated by this selected flow.

rows.evidence: Local single-user SOPS/age store and bounded consumption interface.
rows.remaining: Shared production secrets service, CI identities, rotation automation and cloud backends are separate work.

rows.evidence: ORODI contracts, controls, eligibility, snapshot projection, Grafana alerts and host-history observations.
rows.remaining: Alch host evidence remains workflow/simulation; no full live product-control verdict or acknowledged telemetry export follows.

rows.evidence: Body War canary routing/workload/evaluator/controller, rollback, observer, pinned lab and commissioning interface exist.
rows.remaining: Application-specific lab; independent live generated-Alch service readiness, production actuation and teardown evidence require their own exact runs.

rows.evidence: Active deterministic Markdown/normalized SPEC parser and emitter; fresh fixture derivation yields 263 obligations.
rows.remaining: 47 fixture obligations need formalization; generic binding-free output uses todo, hybrid output can skip. No direct shared-graph/general TDE join demonstrated.

rows.evidence: Portable 0.4 kit with Rust core, verifier and Souffle/Alloy/CBMC/Lean/TLC adapters; archive matches recorded 104-test validation.
rows.remaining: Bundled examples and exact bounds, not automatic TDE integration or arbitrary app correctness; tools need separate installations and TLC caveat remains.

rows.evidence: Factory locks provider inputs, repeats isolated processes and rejects inconsistent evidence; BTE implementation remains present.
rows.remaining: General EVF adapter and BTE absorption are distinct unfinished/gated streams; same-host bounded proof is not production conformance.

rows.evidence: DomainSpec certifier binds finite projection, independent Lean decoder and proof unit; EVF has multiple formal adapters.
rows.remaining: A proof of a selected model does not prove source preservation, all generated application behavior or production runtime correspondence.

rows.evidence: Separate evidence consumer and authority roles are explicit; source-bound acceptance exists for selected historical candidates.
rows.remaining: General independently consumed source-to-TDE-to-EVF chain is not closed. IOLM is one named independent consumer, not a requirement for every application.

rows.evidence: Compiler package inventory, SBOM, unsigned in-toto/SLSA-shaped provenance, qualification and offline verifier.
rows.remaining: Clean candidate/CI qualification still required; no signing identity or SLSA level follows from schema shape or checksums.

rows.evidence: ECS/Fargate/Postgres target and SQS candidate recipe; plan/generate/verify/qualification commands.
rows.remaining: Recipe generation/qualification does not deploy or establish cloud-provider behavior; consumer app and migration inventory remain inputs.

rows.evidence: Local restart, fault, retry, canary and recovery evidence supplies useful building blocks.
rows.remaining: No joined production SLO/load/capacity evidence, cross-region HA, backup restoration RPO/RTO or disaster-recovery acceptance for the generated-app flow.

rows.evidence: Current stable compiler denominator is backend types; UI candidates are separately retained.
rows.remaining: General generated frontend, accessibility, browser compatibility and complete user workflows are not demonstrated by this compiler path.

rows.area: Privacy, audit retention and data governance
rows.evidence: Source provenance and durable application history exist.
rows.remaining: Operational evidence is not a compliance audit trail; retention/deletion, data-subject workflows, residency and tenant privacy need explicit requirements and tests. Semantic host retains outbox/inbox indefinitely.

rows.evidence: Typed rejection, exact input identities, tests and bounded isolation address portions of secure development.
rows.remaining: No requirement-by-requirement ASVS/SSDF/SLSA mapping or full vulnerability/incident-response evidence was established. A percentage or compliance claim is unsupported.
